duration.$description: Durations by purpose. Anyone who asks for reduced motion gets 0.01ms regardless (uids-core.scss).

fast.$description: Hover and focus feedback: form field focus and select options (form.scss), and the circle button's ring (button.scss).

medium.$description: State changes and small movement: the toggle switch (form.scss), accordion icons (accordion.scss), menu and tab indicators (menu.scss, tabs.scss) and the button focus bar (_utilities.scss).

slow.$description: Larger movement and slower changes: the stat reveal and expanding stat content (stat.scss), tab backgrounds (tabs.scss), banner media (banner.scss) and blockquote bars (blockquote.scss).
